synopsis: Dark-fantasy realism 8k cinematic gladiator power-up trailer. A floating aerial camera approaches and dives into the Stage 1 Common Colosseum as the stadium crowd roars. In the center stone battle ring, the three rookie Newblood Stable starter creatures—the Common Dragon, Stegosaurus, and Dire Wolf—visibly power up mid-shot via glowing genetic runes, erupting into their ultimate Primal Apex, Colossus, and Ravager forms, uniting as World Champions.

assetCards.name: char_dragon_primal-v2_body
assetCards.prompt: 8k dark-fantasy realism, full-body studio reference on a solid light gray background. A colossal Tier 7 World Primal Apex wyvern-dragon with jagged black obsidian scales and swept-back obsidian crown horns, its parted fanged jaws roaring with violet astral fire. Its four massive spread bat wings radiate surging energy: emerald-green Colossus crystal spikes, royal-purple Mythic nebula lightning, blazing molten-crimson Ravager lava, and electric-cyan Phantom plasma. Wide leathery wings, long whipping tail, taloned limbs.

assetCards.name: char_stego_colossus-v2_body
assetCards.prompt: 8k dark-fantasy realism, full-body studio reference on a solid light gray background. A massive, battle-hardened quadruped Colossus Stegosaurus dinosaur on four thick pillar legs. Its arched spine is crowned with a towering double row of translucent emerald-green crystal dorsal plates and jagged osteoderms pulsing with bright green alchemical light, with a heavy spiked tail, rough moss-stone hide, and a rugged horned beak with sharp twin brow horns.

assetCards.name: char_wolf_ravager-v2_body
assetCards.prompt: 8k dark-fantasy realism, full-body studio reference on a solid light gray background. A ferocious, heavily muscled Ravager dire wolf in a coiled predatory lunge on razor-clawed paws. Volcanic black basalt hide cracked with blazing molten-crimson and lava-orange fissures across its chest and shoulders, with a bristling spined mane of roaring fire and glowing ember eyes, baring sharp ivory fangs.

As its front paws strike the flagstones, roaring molten-crimson magma veins ignite across its chest and spined mane, transforming it mid-leap into @char_wolf_ravager-v2_body. The camera pulls back swiftly at 15 km/h to reveal @char_dragon_primal-v2_body, @char_stego_colossus-v2_body, and @char_wolf_ravager-v2_body standing united in the stone ring under swirling embers and four-colour elemental firelight.
